mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_shopping_list(user_id,week_start,sync_version,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{weekStart},0,'DRAFT',NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,week_start,sync_version,status,synced_at,created_at,updated_at FROM diet_shopping_list WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND week_start=#{weekStart}
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_shopping_list SET sync_version=sync_version+1,synced_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diet_shopping_item WHERE list_id=#{listId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND manual=0
mapper.select: SELECT id,list_id,user_id,name,category,quantity,unit,source_meal_ids,manual,completed,created_at,updated_at FROM diet_shopping_item WHERE list_id=#{listId} AND user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY completed,category,manual,name
SELECT id,list_id,user_id,name,category,quantity,unit,source_meal_ids,manual,completed,created_at,updated_at FROM diet_shopping_item WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_shopping_item SET name=#{name},category=#{category},quantity=#{quantity},unit=#{unit},completed=#{completed},updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
